title: 第5章 收获身份的提升第6章 入籍危险临近
content_zh:
良心没了，果然可以赚得更多。
苏牧有些惊喜地看着面前的收获。
之前慌乱之下，他虽然没忘摸尸，但当时也没来得及查看到底都摸到了些什么。
现在一清点，三个乞丐身上，竟然有足足四百二十文钱！
其中单是冯德宝一人身上，就搜出来了二百五十文。
除了三铢钱，剩下的就是一些乱七八糟的零碎，吃了一半的烧饼、又干又硬的馒头、碎布头等等，都没什么价值。
指望三个乞丐身上有什么好东西显然不太现实。
能得到四百二十文钱已经是意外之喜了，再有什么奢望那就是贪婪了。
“四百二十文，加上我原有的三百五十文，现在我手里已经有七百七十文钱，换一个户籍绰绰有余。”
苏牧仔细地把所有三铢钱都装进破布口袋里，和自己原本的三铢钱收在一起。
胸前沉甸甸的感觉，让他莫名地有些心安。
钱是英雄胆，果然，不管在哪里，钱都是底气啊。
“虽然钱够了，但是冯德宝三人刚刚被杀死，我如果马上去换户籍，难免会引起有心人的注意。”
经过今晚的事情，苏牧越发地谨慎了。
他很清楚，现在的他虽然刀法入门了，但在这武陵城中，依旧是底层中的底层。
毕竟那些帮派里的人，随便拎出来一个都有可能修炼刀法入门。
就算是没有练过武的，比如冯德宝三人，要不是被自己偷袭了，正面交手，苏牧都不一定是他们的对手。
“最近这些日子不过是砍柴砍得多了点，就被冯德宝他们三个给盯上了。
要是我突然有钱去换户籍，还不定会有什么麻烦呢。”
苏牧心中思忖道，“不着急，再等一些日子，最好等我的伏波刀法小成以后再去换户籍，那样有什么变故也能多些应对之力。”

…………
在计划中熬到了天明，苏牧偷偷地回了一趟破庙，发现冯德宝三人的尸体已经不见了。
他又观察了半晌，发现并没有官差在捉拿他，街头也没有通缉他的告示，心中也是松了口气。
看来他猜得没错，这年头，死三个乞丐跟死三只蚂蚁没什么区别，官差不会太过在意。
不过苏牧也没有大意，他没有再回破庙，而是在和破庙隔了两条街的一个旧祠堂内，用两文钱跟一个小乞丐换了个睡觉的位置。
流民流民，都是有今日没明日的，人口流动根本就没人在意。
为了不引人注意，苏牧依旧每日出城砍柴。
只不过与之前相比，他每日背柴的频率降低了许多。
之前他确实有些着急了，所以才会引起冯德宝三人的注意。
如今每日赚七八文钱，甚至不如大部分乞丐一天乞讨的收获。
如此过了数日，冯德宝三人的消失就像是一朵浪花，在流民聚集的南城区丝毫没有引起波澜，苏牧也终于是放下心来。
这一日，他照例出城，离城三四里的时候，他在路边停下歇脚，顺便从怀里取出大肉包子大口吃了起来。
虽然暂时还没有换户籍，但手里有钱之后，苏牧也没有虐待自己。
住方面暂时没法解决，那就先吃的好一点。
content_en:
If your conscience is gone, you can indeed earn more.
Su Mu looked at the harvest in front of him with some surprise.
Although he did not forget to touch the body in his panic, he did not have time to check what he had touched.
Now after counting, the three beggars actually had a total of four hundred and twenty coins!
Among them, 250 pieces of writing were found on Feng Debao alone.
Apart from the three baht, all that was left was some random odds and ends, half-eaten sesame seed cakes, dry and hard steamed buns, rags, etc., all of little value.
It is obviously unrealistic to expect anything good from three beggars.
It was an unexpected blessing to get four hundred and twenty coins. Any extravagant hope would be greed.
"Four hundred and twenty cash, plus my original 350 cash, now I have 770 cash in hand, which is more than enough to change my household registration."
Su Mu carefully put all the three baht coins into his rag pocket and put them together with his original three baht coins.
The heavy feeling in his chest made him feel inexplicably at ease.
Money is the courage of a hero. Sure enough, no matter where you are, money is the confidence.
"Although I have enough money, Feng Debao and the other three have just been killed. If I change my household registration immediately, it will inevitably attract the attention of interested people."
After what happened tonight, Su Mu became more cautious.
He knew very well that although he had learned swordsmanship now, he was still at the bottom of the bottom in Wuling City.
After all, any one of those gang members might be able to learn swordsmanship.
Even those who have never practiced martial arts, such as Feng Debao and the other three, would not necessarily be their opponents if Su Mu had not been attacked by him in a head-on confrontation.
“I’ve been just chopping a lot of wood these days, and Feng Debao and the others have been targeting me.
If I suddenly had the money to change my household registration, I might not be in any trouble. "
Su Mu thought to himself, "Don't worry, wait a few more days. It's best to wait until I have mastered the Fubo Sword technique before changing my household registration. That way I will be more prepared to deal with any changes."
…………
After staying up until dawn in the plan, Su Mu secretly returned to the ruined temple and found that the bodies of Feng Debao and the others had disappeared.
He observed for a while and found that no official was arresting him, and there were no wanted notices on the streets, and he felt relieved.
It seems that his guess was right. These days, the death of three beggars is no different from the death of three ants, and the officials will not care too much.
However, Su Mu was not careless. He did not return to the ruined temple. Instead, he exchanged a sleeping position with a little beggar for two pennies in an old ancestral hall two streets away from the ruined temple.
Refugees and refugees all have today and no tomorrow, and no one cares about population mobility at all.
In order not to attract attention, Su Mu still went out of the city to chop firewood every day.
But compared with before, the frequency of carrying firewood every day was much reduced.
He was indeed a little anxious before, so he attracted the attention of Feng Debao and the others.
Nowadays, the seven or eight cash earned per day is not even as much as what most beggars earn from begging in one day.
After several days of this, the disappearance of Feng Debao and the others was like a wave, causing no ripples in the Nancheng District where refugees gathered, and Su Mu finally felt relieved.
On this day, he went out of the city as usual. When he was three or four miles away from the city, he stopped by the roadside to rest, took out the big meat buns from his arms and ate them.
Although he has not changed his household registration yet, Su Mu did not abuse himself after he had money.
If we can’t solve the problem of housing for the time being, then we need to eat better first.
